entry.title: PotentialCrates 1.0.2
entry.summary: **PotentialCrates 1.0.2** - The DIG page's big button is now SEARCH (Discogs, with your filters). ROLL and MILD / MEDIUM / WILD moved to the FILTERS page, next to SEARCH. ROLL is still on the CRATES page too.

entry.title: PotentialCrates 1.0.1
entry.summary: ## PotentialCrates 1.0.1 - The **SYNC** switch on the DIG page is now labelled **TRANSPORT SYNC**, as in Crate Digger. When it's on, a track you tap loads and waits, silent, until you press Play on the MPC, and the MPC's Stop pauses it. Handy for cueing the sampler. Nothing else has changed. Your projects, settings and channels.txt carry over. ## Downloads - `PotentialCrates-1.0.1-mpc-sdk.zip`: the plugin folder for a **Gen1** MPC on MPC OS 3.10.1+ (what MPC TOOLS installs) - `PotentialCrates-1.

entry.title: PotentialCrates 1.0.0
